_comment: The canonical gear-loop fixture. The natural post-onboarding economy (inventory_loop tops out at 2 gold; economy_loop spends its whole 5-gold arc on the traveler_charm accessory buy) cannot cheaply reach a genuine over-capacity accessory refusal: the cheapest 2-item shop combination whose combined resonance (1+2=3) exceeds the fixed resonance_capacity (2) is hedge_ward_charm (9g) + stonescale_talisman (35g) = 44 gold, far beyond what a hand-authored script can plausibly grind via repeated dirty_table chores. This fixture instead seeds the FULL 19-item catalog directly into inventory (same convention as near_mage_cast/near_tactician -- skip an irrelevant grind, test the exact mechanic), which doubles as the 'full pack' (19 items possible) scroll/clip proof the plan also calls for. Warrior L1, standing at the inn spawn (2,3), rusty_sword/leather_jerkin pre-equipped (both resonance 0, so resonance_used starts at 0/2). gold 0 -- this script never needs currency. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=9, captured .state), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. This fixture's own canonical never resolves a fight to completion off this rng_state, so its exact value is cosmetic/inert for outcome purposes.
